newsitem.title: USA: Life USA unit launches indexed annuity.
newsitem.headline: Life USA unit launches indexed annuity.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said Tuesday its LifeUSA Insurance Co subsidiary introduced a second generation indexed annuity product.
The product will be underwritten and issued by Allianz Life Insurance Company of North America, which is part of Allianz AG Holding.

Life USA said the ANNU-A-DEX annuity offers an immediate seven percent credit to the total premium payment, current credited interest rates, a guaranteed index participation rate for the entire index period, and no cap on any potential gain.

The index term for the ANNU-A-DEX is seven years. At the end of the index period, the policyholder may elect to begin receiving income, surrender the policy for cash or roll all values over for another seven year index term, Life USA said.
